name: An Example Chronicle
summary: Delete this one once you write the first real chronicle — it is here to show the shape.
description: The intro of a chronicle. It can use **bold**, *italics*, bullet lists and links to [any page of the archive](/lore/gods/chaos).

parts.title: The setup
parts.text: A chronicle is written like any other entry: sections with a title, and inside each one text, pictures, or text with a picture beside it.
And the last section. Add as many as the story needs — the Contents list at the top builds itself from their titles.
